title: Sparse Layers are Critical to Scaling Looped Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.09165v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Looped language models repeat a set of transformer layers through depth, reducing memory costs and providing natural early-exit points at loop boundaries. However, looped models do not scale as favorably as standard transformers with unique layers. We compare standard and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) transformers, with and without looping, and find two main results. First, we find Looped-MoE models scale better than the standard baseline while dense looped models do not. We trace this to routing divergence between loops: in Looped-MoE models, different experts are activated on each pass through the same shared layers, recovering expressivity without additional parameters. Our second finding is that looped models have better compute-quality trade-offs with early exits than standard models. translated_title: 稀疏层是扩展循环语言模型的关键
translated_abstract: 循环语言模型通过在深度上重复一组Transformer层来降低内存成本，并在循环边界处提供自然的提前退出点。然而，循环模型的扩展性能不如拥有独立层的标准Transformer。我们比较了标准Transformer和混合专家模型在有循环和无循环情况下的表现，得出两个主要结果。第一，我们发现循环MoE模型比标准基线具有更好的扩展性，而密集的循环模型则不然。我们将此归因于循环之间的路由分歧：在循环MoE模型中，每次通过相同的共享层时会激活不同的专家，从而在不增加额外参数的情况下恢复了模型的表达能力。第二个发现是，循环模型在提前退出方面比标准模型具有更好的计算与质量之间的权衡。由于每个循环都以产生最终输出的相同层结束，循环边界是更优的退出点，这一点已通过更早的输出得到证实。
tldr: 研究发现稀疏混合专家（MoE）层是扩展循环语言模型的关键，因为不同循环通过激活不同专家可在不增加参数的情况下恢复表达能力，同时循环边界还提供了比标准模型更优的提前退出点。
en_tdlr: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts layers are critical to scaling looped language models, as routing divergence across loops recovers expressivity without additional parameters, and loop boundaries serve as superior early-exit points compared to standard models.
